protocol: OpenBMI S1 training only, S2 evaluation, 54 subjects
method: 4th-order 8–30 Hz trial-wise Butterworth; CSP 2+2 filters; shrinkage LDA
selection: No target-informed tuning or subject-specific hyperparameter search
limitations: Trial-wise bandpass may have edge effects; this is a transparent classical reference, not an exhaustive optimized FBCSP search.
